name: Mailchimp
one_liner: Email marketing platform with a Marketing API (v3.0) for audiences, contacts, campaigns, reports and e-commerce data. Transactional (Mandrill) is a separate API.
auth_notes: API key with full account access (no scoping, no expiry); OAuth 2 via Registered Apps (client_id and client_secret) for multi-user apps.
access_notes: API key and OAuth app registration are self-serve in a Mailchimp account; a Free plan exists. Whether specific features are plan-limited was not verified.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve API key and OAuth 2 registration, broad documented REST API (about 311 reference pages), webhooks, batch operations, documented limits (10 simultaneous connections). The official MCP only searches docs.

identity.quote: Mailchimp Transactional (formerly Mandrill) sends targeted and event-driven messages via the API or SMTP

auth.quote: There is no way to issue a read-only key or restrict one to particular endpoints
Navigate to the Registered Apps page in your Mailchimp account

api_surface.quote: The Marketing API has a limit of 10 simultaneous connections.
Keep your data store in sync with your Mailchimp audience via webhooks.

mcp.quote: This searches documentation, not your Mailchimp account.

buildability.quote: The root url for the API is https://api.mailchimp.com/3.0/.

disputes.why: API key and OAuth app registration are self-serve in any account, and a Free plan exists.
API reference llms.txt index lists about 311 endpoint pages.
The official MCP server only searches docs and cannot act on an account; no account-level MCP found.
No evidence of plan gating on the API; self-serve credentials and broad documented API.
Official GitHub org has marketing SDK repos for Go, Rust and Java.
